en.html:
Chachamaru"BOLO, YAAR! ONE WORD! We have built an entire dream for two statues to mind their own bloody business!!"
Hikaru"I did expect this. But EXACTLY this, Kageaki? Even my prediction you have left with nothing to do!!"
Chachamaru"Apun is losing hope, boss. This fellow cannot be defeated. Princess, now what?"
Hikaru"Hm... Maybe that was the mistake. Too much freedom to act, I gave him."
Chachamaru"Matlab?"

ja.html:
茶々丸「何も起きねぇーーーーーーーーーーっ!!」
光「実は予想していたが、全く予想の通りとは かえって恐れ入ったぞ景明!!」
茶々丸「なんかもう勝てる気しないっす。 　御姫、次はどうするの？」
光「うむ…… 　景明に行動の自由を与え過ぎたことが誤り だったのかもしれん」
茶々丸「つーと？」
